listen_address.description: Network interface address for ACME protocol (HTTP/HTTPS) listeners.

management_address.description: Network interface address for the management API listener.

certificate_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate used by Pebble for ACME HTTPS.

private_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key used by Pebble for ACME HTTPS.

ca_certificate_path.description: Path to the CA intermediate certificate used for ACME chain building.

ocsp_responder_url.description: OCSP responder URL for certificate status checks (optional; empty disables OCSP).

http_port.description: Port number for HTTP-01 challenge validation.

https_port.description: Port number for HTTPS (ACME main endpoint).

management_port.description: Port number for Pebble management API (e.g., account/CSR introspection).

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP requests Pebble will accept.

max_memory_bytes.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) Pebble is allowed to use before rejecting new requests.

rate_limit_max_requests_per_domain_per_d.description: Maximum number of certificate requests allowed per domain per 24h.

rate_limit_max_pending_authorizations_pe.description: Maximum pending authorizations per ACME account.

rate_limit_max_certificates_per_domain_p.description: Maximum certificates issued per domain per 7-day period.

features_enable_strict.description: Enable strict ACME protocol compliance (reject non-conforming requests).

features_enable_nosct.description: Enable issuance of certificates without SCTs (for testing only).

domains.description: List of domains Pebble is authorized to issue certificates for.

account_keys.description: List of pre-provisioned account public keys (in JWK format) to pre-authorize.

webroot.description: Directory used for HTTP-01 challenge file storage (if not using a custom solver).

revocation_endpoint.description: Override path for revocation requests (leave blank for default /acme/revoke-cert).

revocation_reason.description: Default revocation reason code (e.g., 0 = unspecified; see RFC 5280).
